question: Can an adaptive repair loop that detects one-hop failures and generates corrective examples be feasibly implemented and sustained in a language model-based KGQA system without causing instability or overfitting?
description: Investigate whether adaptive repair loops have been used in similar contexts (e.g., program repair, data purification) and assess their applicability to KGQA fact verification.
rationale: If the repair loop is infeasible, the proposed method may not work as intended.
